name: page-ads-banner
note: `ENABLE_ADS_BANNER=true`, the one fixture that takes the `{% if enable_ads_header %}` branch of `base.html:172` — every other case renders the shell with the branch off, which is production's default (`config.py:29`) and is exactly why the branch needs a case of its own. The banner is a `<div>` of static markup inside `<nav id="header">`, so it is also the fixture that shows whether the surrounding `nav` came out identical when the conditional did fire. The body is an ordinary paragraph so that nothing else in the case can account for a difference.
